segments.speaker: interviewer
segments.text: Sir, I love Forbidden Science 7. It's a very tantalizing book, you dropped lots of hints. And one of the things you say is that only around 2025 did clear answers finally emerge. Jacques, what were those answers? What were the clear answers that finally emerged in 2025 for you?

segments.speaker: interviewee
segments.text: The first clear answer came from — you know, the US government and other governments around the world had been waiting for that — and it was that the subject was a real research subject, a valid research topic, and that the conventional explanations did not work. Now, that is not exactly disclosure in the sense that people expect, that is maybe still to come, but at least that was a clear breakthrough. And it immediately triggered, in Europe and around the world, it was like giving permission to the scientists who had been working on the project to restart their own organizations.

segments.speaker: interviewer
segments.text: I guess it legitimized the idea of taking the subject of UAP seriously for the first time.

segments.speaker: interviewee
segments.text: Yes. Well, as you know, France has had a long-term group — actually two different groups — that have been studying this since the 1970s. So, in an official capacity, it was a very small cell of just watching for things coming over, and it was sort of an alert system. But they've accumulated a database that's very interesting, and I was in contact with them and I collaborated with them. Now that group is being re-established, and I've been asked to join it officially. So I will be — you know, this is an advisory board essentially for the French government — and I will be joining it in two weeks.
